title: Demonstrations of the Potential of AI-based Political Issue Polling

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating survey responses by prompting the model with specific ideological personas (ranging from very liberal to very conservative) and comparing the generated ordinal policy preference scores and distributions to human polling data from the Cooperative Election Study (CES).

Simulating survey responses by prompting the model with specific age ranges and comparing the generated policy preference scores to human polling data to assess if the model accurately reflects, exaggerates, or misses age-related opinion trends.

Simulating survey responses by prompting the model with male and female personas and comparing the generated policy preference scores to human polling data to evaluate the accuracy of simulated gender-based differences in policy opinions.

Simulating survey responses by prompting the model with white and non-white personas and comparing the generated policy preference scores to human polling data to evaluate the accuracy of simulated race-based differences in policy opinions.
